# ADR-3029: A03: OS command passthrough for tool wrapper 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Passthrough arguments become shell metacharacters.

## Decision

Wrappers SHALL NOT allow an OS command passthrough for tool wrapper 5 (A03-5).

## Consequences

Validate against an allow-list of verbs.
